title: SPE Chapter 06 - Session: PHP Session Management
description:
Chapter 06 of Simple PHP Engine - adding PHP sessions for persistent state.

This tutorial covers:
• Sticky URL parameters via session storage
• Flash messages for one-time notifications
• Visit tracking with timestamps
• Session reset and lifecycle management
• timeAgo() helper with match expressions
• Three-tier fallback: URL → session → default
